ts_bridge: Core integrations, providers, notifications and shared services for TroyScripts.
ts_nlplates: Dutch-style license plates and registration documents for FiveM.
ts_nlplates_migrate: One-time tool that converts old license plates with hyphens (A-123-BC) to spaces (A 123 BC). Remove after use.
ts_flatbed: Ramps, winch and vehicle transport using a flatbed truck.
ts_repairpoints: Vehicle repair points with ESX on-duty checks.
ts_keycard: Keycards and optional staff identification for different jobs.
ts_hostage: Hostage interactions, controls and FiveM integrations.
ts_antipunch: Combat and camera controls with bridge integration.
ts_nohelmet: Control automatic helmet usage and vehicle seat swapping.
ts_gemertmap: Satellite map and Dutch location labels for Gemert RP.
ts_parkeerapp: Parking payments and police parking enforcement for Gemert RP.
tgc_bot: Discord bot for tickets, moderation, economy, Twitch and YouTube notifications, and the central hub.

ts_bridge.summary: Central integration layer for frameworks, inventories, banking, vehicle systems, notifications, cameras and webhooks.
requirements: ox_lib is required. Select your current ESX, inventory, target, banking and billing providers in the bridge configuration.
The FiveM resource and the private GitHub repository are both named ts_bridge.
install: Place the complete resource in resources/[troyscripts]/ts_bridge, with fxmanifest.lua directly inside that folder.
Set providers, jobs, language and services in config/config.lua. Keep secret webhook URLs only in config/webhook_config.lua.
Start ox_lib and the external providers you use before ts_bridge. Start scripts that depend on the bridge afterwards.
update: Back up config/config.lua and config/webhook_config.lua outside the active resource directory.
Stop dependent resources before stopping ts_bridge. Replace the entire resource, especially if the file structure changed.
Transfer your custom settings and webhooks to the new configuration files. Do not simply increase the configuration schema number.
Start ts_bridge first and then restart all scripts that use it.
verify: Run ts_bridge_check in the server console.
Check the configured providers, society payments, screenshots, webhooks and dependent resources.
Check in the server console that version messages of all connected scripts appear through ts_bridge, without HTTP 404.
warnings: Never publish real webhook URLs or API tokens on the public site or GitHub.
A bridge update may require restarting dependent resources.

ts_nlplates.summary: Dutch-style license plates, vehicle registration documents and optional JG/Sky integrations.
requirements: OneSync, ESX, ox_lib, oxmysql, ox_inventory and ts_bridge are required.
For paid registration documents, the configured police society account must exist; the documentation uses society_police.
JG Dealerships, JG Advanced Garages and MrNewbVehicleKeys are optional integrations and are not required for every server.
Repeated checks with ts_nlplates_check require ts_bridge 1.2.2 or newer.
install: Place the full ts_nlplates resource, including textures/, stream/, fxmanifest.lua and config/.
Import sql/install.sql for the new registration data.
Add only the missing registration document item to ox_inventory/data/items.lua. Supply the kentekenbewijs.png icon yourself.
Configure your license plate format and any optional JG integrations according to the included documentation.
update: Back up the resource, configurations and database before replacing files.
Replace the complete resource folder. Transfer your custom settings to config/config.lua and webhook settings to config/webhooks.lua.
Existing saved license plates containing hyphens require a separate offline migration. Changing Config.PlateFormat alone does not modify stored vehicles.
Check existing JG/Sky integrations and restart the server if items or license plates have been migrated.
verify: Check that a newly created vehicle, garage and key system all use the same plate.
Open a supported glovebox and view or show a registration document.
If paid documents are enabled, verify replacement costs and the society_police account.
Run ts_nlplates_check in the server console and check the version message through ts_bridge.
warnings: The optional offline license plate migration is a separate resource and must not be started by default.
The current README states that kentekenbewijs.png is not supplied.

ts_nlplates_migrate.summary: One-time maintenance tool that converts old ts_nlplates license plates with hyphens (A-123-BC) in the database to spaces (A 123 BC). It does not replace ts_nlplates and is not meant to run permanently.
requirements: Only needed if your database still contains license plates with hyphens from an older ts_nlplates version.
oxmysql must be running. ESX, ts_bridge and other scripts are not needed and must be stopped during the migration.
A full database backup and a maintenance window without players.
The affected database tables must use InnoDB.
install: Make a full database backup and put the server in maintenance. Block new connections through your hosting; kicking players alone is not enough.
Let all players leave and stop ESX, inventory, garages, dealerships, keys and every other resource that writes vehicle data. Keep only oxmysql running.
Place the folder as ts_nlplates_migrate on your server, but do not add it to server.cfg.
Check in config.lua that your own resources that write vehicle data are listed in BlockedResources.
Start the tool manually in the server console: start ts_nlplates_migrate.
Run ts_nlplates_spaties controle. This only reads. Resolve any collisions or invalid data first and check again.
Then run ts_nlplates_spaties uitvoeren.
Check the result, remove the ts_nlplates_migrate folder from your server and restart the full server.
update: You only need this tool once. If your database has already been converted, there is nothing to update.
If you do need to migrate again, follow the installation steps with a new backup.
verify: Check a few vehicles in owned_vehicles: plates use spaces, for example A 123 BC.
Test a garage, the glovebox and the registration document in-game.
Make sure ts_nlplates_migrate is no longer on your server and not in server.cfg.
warnings: Never add this tool to server.cfg and never let it start automatically.
Remove the tool from your server after use.
Test on a copy of your database first. KVP, hashes, encrypted data and external storage are not fully converted; check your own integrations separately.
The commands only work in the server console, not for players.
preserve: database backup from before the migration

ts_flatbed.summary: Ramps, winch, remote control and wheel-lift functions for supported recovery vehicles.
requirements: OneSync, ox_lib, ox_target and ts_bridge are required.
A compatible vehicle resource must be installed. Supported models include energyrampamec and energyguinchotop (from energy_vehtopgear).
When job restrictions are enabled, the selected framework must be available through ts_bridge.
install: Install the full resource folder named ts_flatbed.
Keep the separate vehicle resource installed and start it before ts_flatbed. Adjust Config.Models for other vehicle spawn names.
Configure ox_lib, ox_target and ts_bridge as usual. No SQL tables or inventory items are required.
update: Back up config.lua and calibration.json.
Replace the script files and transfer your custom models, permissions and settings to the latest config.lua.
Keep calibration.json, which stores existing vehicle calibrations.
verify: Test ramps, winch loading/unloading and braking on level ground.
Check a second vehicle on the wheel lift. Adjust model calibrations with /flatbedmeten and /flatbedafstellen if needed.
warnings: The required vehicle models are not included with ts_flatbed.
Do not reuse an old config file without checking for newly added settings.

ts_repairpoints.summary: Vehicle repair locations with a mechanic NPC or marker, damage-based prices and society payments.
requirements: OneSync, es_extended, ox_lib and ts_bridge are required. The default NPC mode uses ox_target; marker mode can work without it.
The configured mechanic and police society accounts must exist.
Use a recent FiveM server artifact supporting server-side NPC and vehicle operations.
Periodic version checks (IntervalHours) require ts_bridge 1.2.2 or newer.
install: Install the resource under the exact name ts_repairpoints and configure config/config.lua.
Choose NPC (ox_target) or marker (E), and configure mechanic jobs, on-duty checks and society accounts.
Create points with /reparatiepunt plaatsen or configure fixed points. New installs have no active sample points.
The current resource does not require an SQL import.
update: Back up the complete data directory, especially data/points.json and data/compensation.json, if present.
Transfer custom locations, job names, society settings and duty checks to the new config.
Replace the script files without deleting saved repair data or outstanding compensation records.
verify: Check that a repair point becomes unavailable while a mechanic is on duty.
Test the quoted repair price, player payment and mechanic society income.
If an NPC target fails, run /reparatietargetcheck.
Check the version message through ts_bridge in the server console (no HTTP 404).
warnings: ox_target is required for NPC mode; marker mode is an alternative.
Verify your banking and society integration before testing payments.

ts_keycard.summary: Job keycards, forgery features and optional staff ID cards using 0r_idcard.
requirements: OneSync, ESX, ox_lib, ox_inventory, ox_target and ts_bridge are required.
Configured job names and associated society accounts must exist.
0r_idcard is optional for staff ID cards. Ordinary keycards still function without it.
install: Install the resource under the exact name ts_keycard and start it after ts_bridge.
Copy missing item definitions from install/items/ox_inventory_item.txt into the existing return { ... } of ox_inventory/data/items.lua.
Copy the corresponding icons from install/images/ into ox_inventory/web/images/.
Configure departments, payments, issue locations and optional 0r_idcard support; create service counters using /kaartpunt.
update: Back up config/config.lua, config/server.lua and all private webhook URLs.
Replace the complete previous resource folder so that old Lua files do not remain.
Merge newly required Config.Departments and other fields. Do not change only Config.Version.
Preserve stored keycard locations and records; start ox_inventory and ts_bridge before ts_keycard.
verify: Issue a card for each installed job and verify pricing and society payments.
Test forged cards, door permissions, stolen cards and the revocation cooldown.
If 0r_idcard is used, test staff ID issuing both with and without that integration.
warnings: Combine item definitions with your existing ox_inventory items; never add duplicates.
When integrated with 0r_idcard, the separate staff ID NPC may need disabling in that resource's configuration.

ts_hostage.summary: Hostage interactions on foot or in vehicles, police alerts, camera controls and optional screenshot integration.
requirements: OneSync, ox_lib and ts_bridge are required. ESX is used for the documented police integration.
ox_target is only needed for target interactions; screenshot-basic is optional for Discord photos.
install: Install ts_hostage as a complete resource alongside other TroyScripts.
Use config/config.lua for general settings and config/server_config.lua for private server-side settings.
Start ts_bridge before ts_hostage. Start ox_target and screenshot-basic only if their related features are enabled.
update: Wait until there are no active hostage situations. Stop ts_hostage and make a full backup.
Replace the old resource and keep the new fxmanifest.lua.
Move previous config.lua settings into config/config.lua and server_config.lua settings into config/server_config.lua.
Restart ts_hostage after restarting ts_bridge.
verify: With two players, test hands up, taking a hostage, releasing the player and restoring weapon state.
Check camera restoration, the radial menu, police alerts and optional screenshots.
warnings: Keep private webhook URLs in server-only files.
If Electron resource protection is enabled, whitelist the involved resources and screenshot-basic as needed.

ts_antipunch.summary: Combat restrictions and central camera handling through ts_bridge.
requirements: Requires a compatible camera and combat API in ts_bridge, which uses ox_lib.
No separate ESX, inventory, ox_target or SQL integration is required.
install: Install the full ts_antipunch folder, including config/ and shared/.
Start ox_lib and ts_bridge first. If you also use ts_hostage, start ts_antipunch before it.
update: Back up config/config.lua and any custom translations.
Stop ts_antipunch and replace the entire previous folder, including obsolete root-level files.
Transfer custom settings and the selected MeleeCancelMode to the latest configuration.
verify: Test melee and shooting without aiming, reloading and camera changes.
When using ts_hostage, ensure camera controls return to normal after releasing a hostage.
warnings: Some older installation documents contain conflicting config schema instructions. Compare actual settings in the latest package; never increase a schema version blindly.

ts_nohelmet.summary: Disable automatic motorcycle helmets, prevent automatic seat shuffling and use /schuif.
requirements: ox_lib and ts_bridge are required for the radial menu and seat-switch functions.
No dedicated ESX, SQL or inventory items are required.
install: Install ts_nohelmet and confirm fxmanifest.lua is in the resource root.
Start ox_lib and ts_bridge before ts_nohelmet.
Set helmet blocking, automatic seat shuffling and the radial menu in config/config.lua.
update: Back up your config/config.lua and remove obsolete files from the previous resource.
Review any new options and restart the resource after changing its config.
verify: Let the driver leave a vehicle and confirm the passenger does not automatically move to the driver's seat.
Test /schuif both ways and the Switch front seat option in the radial menu.
Check automatic helmet behavior on motorcycles.
Check the version message through ts_bridge in the server console (no HTTP 404).
warnings: The other front seat must be unoccupied before switching.

ts_gemertmap.summary: Dutch satellite map, postal codes, navigation and configurable radar zoom.
requirements: FiveM map streaming for .ytd/.ydd assets and ox_lib are required.
There is no mandatory dependency on ESX, SQL, ts_bridge or inventory.
install: Install the entire ts_gemertmap folder, including stream/ and data/, and start ox_lib first.
Make sure that no other resource streams the same minimap*.ytd or minimap.gfx files.
Configure custom area names, postal code points and radar zoom in config/config.lua.
update: Back up your map settings and the full old resource.
After backing up, remove the old folder and install the complete package. Transfer settings to config/config.lua.
Restart the complete FiveM server to refresh streamed map textures and the minimap.
verify: Test the minimap, pause menu map and /postcode command.
Check /postcode uit and /gemertmapreset after respawning.
Verify radar zoom works with your chosen HUD.
Check the ts_gemertmap version message in the server console (no HTTP 404).
warnings: This resource runs independently; ts_bridge is not required.
Other resources streaming the same minimap files may cause conflicts.

ts_parkeerapp.summary: Parking sessions, payments, police plate checks and fine evidence photos in Sky Phone.
requirements: Sky Phone (tested with 1.6.1), OneSync, oxmysql, ox_lib, ESX and ts_bridge are required.
Custom/external apps must be enabled in Sky Phone's active settings.
Banking, fire department revenue accounts and any fine accounts must exist in the bridge. FiveManage is configured through Sky Phone.
install: Install ts_parkeerapp as its own resource and import sql/install.sql into the same MariaDB database used by ESX and Sky Phone.
First test Sky Phone's own camera and gallery uploads.
Set the fire department account, police jobs, prices and fines in config.lua.
Start ts_parkeerapp after oxmysql, ox_lib, ts_bridge and sky_phone.
update: Back up the database, config.lua and existing parking sessions.
Replace the script files and transfer custom prices, police jobs, banking and fire department settings.
Do not delete active sessions or unpaid charges during the update.
Optionally copy the new versionCheck = true line into config.lua; if it is missing, the version check is on.
verify: Test a one-minute parking session, bank debit and credit to the fire department.
With another player, test police plate searches, camera evidence, GPS and parking fines.
Test restarting with an active or unpaid parking session.
Check the version message through ts_bridge in the server console.
warnings: The app manages its own fines; do not automatically create a duplicate Apex Billing invoice.
Sky Phone manages media uploads; never publish your private FiveManage key on this website.

tgc_bot.summary: Discord bot for ticketing, economy, notifications, moderation with warning management, a suggestion box, reminders, temporary voice channels, radio and the central hub.
requirements: Node.js 24.x on existing bot hosting, a Discord application and your own bot token.
Complete bot files, including package.json and package-lock.json.
Persistent storage for the SQLite database, logs and backups. Node.js 22 is no longer supported.

Bot permissions for the optional features: Manage Channels and Move Members (temporary voice channels), Create Public Threads in the suggestion channel and Moderate Members/Kick Members (warning escalation).
install: Create your application in the Discord Developer Portal, enable required gateway intents and grant appropriate role permissions.
Upload the full bot project to your Node.js host. index.js and package.json must be in the same project root.
Create a private .env containing TOKEN, CLIENT_ID, GUILD_ID and OWNER_IDS. Never commit it to GitHub.
Run npm ci --no-audit --no-fund and start the bot with npm start.
Use setup mode and /help to check your Discord server settings.

Optional – suggestion box: /config instellen instelling:Suggestions.Channel waarde:#ideas, then set Suggestions.Enabled to ja. Members post ideas with /suggestie; staff review them with the buttons below each idea.

Optional – temporary voice channels: create a voice channel such as "➕ Create channel", set it with /config instellen instelling:TempVoice.CreateChannel and set TempVoice.Enabled to ja. Members manage their channel with /voice naam, limiet, slot and overnemen.
Reminders (/herinner nieuw, lijst, verwijderen) are enabled by default; set the maximum per member with Reminders.MaxPerUser.

Optional – automatic warning escalation: set Warnings.Escalation to ja and choose Warnings.TimeoutAt, Warnings.TimeoutMinutes and Warnings.KickAt. Staff revoke warnings with /warnings verwijderen or /warnings wissen.
update: Stop the central hub and connected bots. Back up the database, .env, uploads and custom settings.
Upload the entire release, including matching package.json and package-lock.json. Do not upload Windows node_modules to a Linux host.
Run npm ci. Start the hub first, followed by connected bots.
Check radio playback after FFmpeg or voice dependency updates and document any environment changes.
verify: Check console logs, gateway connection and slash commands.
Test tickets, notifications and hub communication in a test Discord server.
Test radio playback after updating FFmpeg or voice dependencies.
After configuring, test the suggestion box (/suggestie), a reminder (/herinner nieuw wanneer:2m) and creating and cleaning up a temporary voice channel.
warnings: This is a standalone Discord bot, not a FiveM resource. Do not add an ensure line to server.cfg.
Never upload TOKEN, .env, databases or other private files to the public changelog website.
Temporary voice channels require the bot permissions Manage Channels and Move Members; without them no channels are created.
